description: Oscillator carrying saw, square, triangle, sine and a sub sine at once, with through-zero linear FM and polyBLEP anti-aliasing

params.text: Sets the octave in whole steps, C0 to C8, with position 4 giving C4 at 261.63Hz
Transposes the oscillator by seven semitones either way, in semitone steps
Transposes the oscillator anywhere within a semitone either way
Attenuates and inverts the EXP FM input, and at full clockwise one volt there moves the pitch by one octave
Attenuates and inverts the LIN FM input; the setting is cubed, so at full clockwise one volt there shifts the frequency by about 1600Hz

inputs.text: A rising edge restarts every waveform at the start of its cycle, with no anti-aliasing on the restart
Master pitch, one volt per octave, added to the pitch set by OCTAVE, COARSE and FINE
Exponential frequency modulation, scaled by the EXP FM knob and added to the pitch in volts per octave
Through-zero linear frequency modulation, scaled by the LIN FM knob; with nothing patched here no linear FM is applied at all

outputs.text: The sawtooth at the oscillator frequency, -5V to 5V
The square, one octave below the sawtooth, -5V to 5V
The triangle, one octave below the sawtooth, -5V to 5V
The sine at the oscillator frequency, -5V to 5V
A sine one octave below the sawtooth, -5V to 5V

notes: there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
